analysis_population: 48 groups x 4 conditions x 20 old-state early/late scored transitions, subset old nA=4; train every model without held-out original session
limitations: original cohort repeatedly examined across RITHM R7-R66; exploratory after selection
old A4 and configuration age unavailable to originally uninformed players; analyst models NOT actor cognition
Endogenous was always last and selected information by price/incentive; not randomized
a model that predicts mean group welfare need not fit joint probability nor long-horizon generated welfare
residual can be marginal miscalibration; its sign does not identify clock covariance
public output contains no participant IDs, individual routes, group histories or individual payoffs

models.analyst_A4: OLD A4 group occupancy, shrink count20 to legal coarse; cannot infer uninformed player cognition
models.analyst_A4_age: OLD A4 + six-person configuration age (1/2/3-4/5+), shrink count25 to analyst_A4; analyst-only
models.analyst_A4_age_payoff: OLD A4 + six-person configuration age + OWN tenure/payoff, shrink count30 to analyst_A4_age; analyst-only
models.legal_coarse: treatment, epoch, own info, own previous route; all occupancy states train-only; LOSO original session
models.legal_payoff_tenure: same + OWN received payoff at previous decision t (<4,4-8,>=8); shrink count 25 to own-tenure; legal at t+1
models.legal_tenure: same + own route tenure (1/2/3-4/5+), shrink count 20

scope: RITHM R66-T3 EXPLORATORY; actual historical original-author 24 sessions reused; noncausal
